<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/service-knowledge`, touching **11** documentable anchor(s).

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx`  _(via KnowledgeService (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx`  _(via KnowledgeService (symbol, a top-level class))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **4** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9e6533bd484770298500ce4f03be2925d7986923` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `6126d613bcfa1aa426ac5c99f4eacc989d6311ae` — the merge of head `46217388a8d037b1dd6c6a51d4a067b6c3236030` into base `9e6533bd484770298500ce4f03be2925d7986923`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 6126d613bcfa1aa426ac5c99f4eacc989d6311ae && git checkout 6126d613bcfa1aa426ac5c99f4eacc989d6311ae
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 9e6533bd484770298500ce4f03be2925d7986923 46217388a8d037b1dd6c6a51d4a067b6c3236030 && git checkout -B drift-repro 9e6533bd484770298500ce4f03be2925d7986923 && git merge --no-ff 46217388a8d037b1dd6c6a51d4a067b6c3236030

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9e6533bd484770298500ce4f03be2925d7986923
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 9e6533bd484770298500ce4f03be2925d7986923` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对

Verdict: REWORK
Head-sha: `2b95b310f274e801312523b76fe77db2afe8f2c7`

L1 reviewer of record for PR #37301 (folded cards #36993 and #36994, epic #37000). Read against GitHub and the PR's committed tree, not against the report.

### Checklist conclusions

- **Form:** open, draft, base `main`. The first line is `Fixes #36993` and the second is `Fixes #36994`. `l1-face` flags `keywords-other-cards` on `Fixes #36994`. The fold is intended: claim 7164885071 folds #36994 into this PR, and every acceptance point of #36994 is delivered. By eye, no other closing keyword sits next to an open card number (#37103, #37287 and #37265 are named without verbs). `Fixes #36993` is not correct yet, because card point 2 is not delivered (fix 2).
- **Premise measured:** holds. #36839 is closed (PR #36850) and #36991 is closed. ADR-0161 lines 60 and 63 name exactly these two defects: the title is read from a field named `title`, and the missing refill.
- **Gate check-runs at 2b95b310:** Lint & Repo Gates `success`, TypeScript Type Check `success`. All runs: 40 success, 17 skipped (all expected per `l1-face`), 0 failed, 1 pending (`Test Core (1/10)`). That is NOT MEASURED until it completes. Changeset, Check Documentation Links, Governed Surface Queue Guard and Spec property liveness are `success`.
- **Accepted deviations:** none. The proposed deviation (card #36993 point 2 not applied) is not accepted, because its stated reason is falsified. See reading R5 and fix 2.
- **Out-of-scope destinations:** (a) Card point 2 is not a #37103 item. #37103 item 2 counts groups in record mode only, and calls chunk mode "today's behaviour". So the report's carrier line (`#37103 · noted not filed`) has no destination, and fix 2 brings the item back into this PR. (b) Fix 1 adds a legacy `title` arm to the gate. Its retirement belongs with the rebuild and recipe-hash work (#37099, ADR-0161 K7), and the seat records it there.
- **File surface:** the diff matches the claim, plus two docs pages outside the claimed surface. `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` (row 46 plus its register line) is forced by `check:system-context-census`, and the report says so. `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx` was named by the docs-drift advisory (PR comment 7164838327) but was not declared as a breach. Both are prose surfaces. The seat revises the claim's file surface in the same round (seat action, not the dev's).
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/36993-knowledge-search-refill-display-title.md`, `'@objectstack/service-knowledge': patch`. The package is published: no `private` key, and `exports` has `.` and `./testing`. The changeset carries `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, and the PR body carries the same two lines.
  - Clause-② no holds. The new `SEARCH_FIRST_ROUND_FACTOR`, `SEARCH_REFILL_FACTOR` and `documentTitleField` are not re-exported from `src/index.ts`, so neither the accept set nor the public surface changes.
  - Metadata-protocol none holds. No key, value or type is added, removed or given a new meaning. `nameField` keeps its ADR-0079 meaning, and the service now reads it.
  - Skills-docs not owed.
  - The changeset sentences need one fix (fix 3).
- **Landing clause:** not now (REWORK). Once fixed: Tier S, not governed, and no L2 is owed (see the L2 verdict below). Before ready, confirm the floor gates and all check-runs green on the new head. `Fixes` then closes both cards. Neither card is `Part of`, so no manual `pm:dispatched` removal is owed.

### Spot-check readings

Setup:
- Fetch: `git fetch origin pull/37301/head:refs/l1/37301 main` gives `2b95b310f274…`. The PR API `head.sha` is the same value.
- Diff: `git diff origin/main...refs/l1/37301` changes 8 files (+448/−29).
- `node scripts/pm/l1-face.mjs --pr 37301` first failed with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: yaml`. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter ./scripts...` matched no project (scripts/ is not a workspace member), so I installed the root's own deps with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter . --ignore-scripts`. `l1-face` then ran: INCOMPLETE (all-checks pending), with the one flag discussed under Form.
- Local run: in a fresh detached worktree at the head, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter "@objectstack/service-knowledge..."` and `OS_SKIP_DTS=1 pnpm --filter "@objectstack/service-knowledge^..." build`, then `npx vitest run` in `packages/services/service-knowledge`: **8 files / 217 tests passed**. This matches the report.

- **R1. Refill mechanics** (`packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-service.ts`):
  - `:558`: the over-fetch is gated by `ctx !== undefined && ctx.isSystem !== true && dataEngine !== undefined`.
  - `:566`: one refill block, so there is no third round by construction.
  - `:569`: only a source whose `answered >= firstAsk(source)` is refilled, so an adapter that caps `topK` is never asked again.
  - `:580`: the removed count is re-based for the refilled sources.
  - `:585`: the count goes only to `logger.debug`.
  - `:591`: `kept.slice(0, topK)`, so `search` still returns `Promise<KnowledgeHit[]>`.
  - No context: `admitSources` (`:861` onward) keeps only non-object sources. This is unchanged and is pinned by the test `no context: … asked topK once` (`[['f1', 5]]`).
- **R2. Ablations reproduced** (sed mutation, run, `git checkout -- src`, `git diff --quiet HEAD`):

  | Mutation | Result |
  |---|---|
  | (A) refill disabled (`if (false && …)`) | 6 red, the 6 the PR names |
  | (B) saturation check replaced by `true` | `an adapter that caps topK … not asked again` and `several sources …` go red, plus 6 older tests |
  | (C) title back to `record.title` | 5 red |
  | (D) field gate back to `'title'` | 2 red |
  | (E) `filtered` ignores `isSystem` | `the system identity: one round of topK …` goes red |

  Each claimed "red without the fix" holds.
- **R3. Return type:** `expectTypeOf(svc.search).returns.toEqualTypeOf<Promise<KnowledgeHit[]>>()` sits in `knowledge-service.test.ts`. `tsconfig.test.json` includes `src/**/*`, so `check:test-typecheck` compiles it. Removed count: the `removed 99 hit(s)` debug assertion plus `out` deep-equal to the single raw hit show nothing else rides on the answer. This satisfies the epic ruling "The count of hits removed by the permission filter is never returned to the caller" and ADR-0161 K9 rule 6.
- **R4. Title** (`knowledge-service.ts:1371` `documentTitle`, `:1447`; `knowledge-source-admission.ts:163` `documentTitleField`):
  - The title comes from `resolveDisplayField` (nameField, then displayNameField, then the derivation).
  - A withheld, empty or non-text value gives `undefined`. A finite number is converted with `String()`.
  - No definition reads `'title'`.
  - `resolveRecordDisplayName` is not called.

  All three What items and all three Acceptance cases of #36994 are covered.
- **R5. Card #36993 point 2: the deviation's reason is falsified for several sources.**
  - The PR's Acceptance note says a refill decided by distinct records "changes no answer". That holds for one source only.
  - Probe (test file written in the worktree, then deleted): topK 3. `s1` holds 100 ranked hits, and the caller may read `rec_0` and `rec_15` (`rec_15` is outside round one's 15). `s2` answers 2 chunks of one readable record, scoring 0.5 and 0.49.
  - At head, the answer is `["s1:rec_0@1","s2:r@0.5","s2:r@0.49"]` with no refill.
  - With `:566` changed to count distinct `sourceId#sourceRecordId`, the answer is `["s1:rec_0@1","s1:rec_15@0.985","s2:r@0.5"]`, and all 149 tests of the two touched suites stay green.
  - The cut half of the reason does hold: `KnowledgeSearchOptions.topK` is "Max number of hits to return" (`packages/spec/src/contracts/knowledge-service.ts:32`), and `search_knowledge` returns "at most `topK`" passages (`knowledge-tools.ts:85`). So the answer must stay at most `topK` chunk hits. That matches the card's own words, "what is returned stays chunk-level hits".
  - Point 2 can therefore only mean the refill decision, and there it changes answers. #37103 does not own it: its item 2 counts groups in record mode, and chunk mode stays "today's behaviour".
  - Verdict: an unaccepted deviation from a maintainer card's What item. The card's Acceptance also lists "several sources".
- **R6. Field gate: the head narrows a check that documents already in the index still need.**
  - main (`knowledge-source-admission.ts:222` at `origin/main`) checked `title` whenever the object declares it; the head (`:262–263`) checks only the display field.
  - Documents indexed under the old title rule stay in a persistent index until a complete reindex rewrites them, and nothing reindexes at boot (#37099 is open). The old check must stay until then; details went to the card thread.
  - The report's `security_findings` line and the maintainer summary's 「权限只会更严」 need correcting at this head.
- **R7. Point 2 of the brief (whole source not searched):** this is what the code does. `servedFieldsOf` adds the display field, and `admitSourceFields` refuses the source. The test `refusal: a caller who may not query the display field gets no hit` asserts `searched() == []`. This is within the cards, not scope creep:
  - #36994's own `Blocked-by` says #36839's "readability check uses the same resolution".
  - #37103 item 4 shares `resolveDisplayField` with #36994.
  - #36839's gate already refused a source over an unqueryable `title`.

  It fails closed and is justified. The only defect is the dropped legacy `title` arm (R6). The other `knowledge-source-admission.ts` changes are within the cards: the header TSDoc, the `documentTitleField` export (internal, not in `index.ts`) and `servedFieldsOf`.
- **R8. Overlap with #37287:** `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=refs/l1/37301 --pr=37287` gives `✓ origin/main: merges cleanly`, `✓ #37287: merges cleanly`, `VERDICT clean exit 0` (#37287 head `c84c242a`).
- **R9. Docs and changeset, read sentence by sentence against the diff:**
  - `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx` §3.2: the five refill sentences match `:558–591`. The title paragraph matches R4. The three replaced "record `title`" sentences (source admission intro, field-level rules bullet, event-sync bullet) match the code.
  - `:190`: "a caller who may read fewer matching rows than survive within it" is garbled (fix 4). The same wording is in the `SEARCH_REFILL_FACTOR` TSDoc at `knowledge-service.ts:1174–1180`.
  - `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx:51–56`: "asks each object source for more hits than `topK`" omits the system identity. "the record's display name" conflates the title with `resolveRecordDisplayName`, which has a `Record #id` floor, and "(`nameField`)" omits the derivation (fix 4).
  - `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` row 46 and the register line `knowledge-service.ts#search | 1 | 46` match `:558`.
  - Changeset bullets 1 and 3 match the code. Bullet 2's last sentence says only that the caller "is not served it as a title", while the code refuses the whole source (fix 3).
- **Report evidence:** commands and counts are real and pinned to the head. The local gates the report marks NOT MEASURED are covered by CI check-runs. I found no git-answerable API reads in the report.

### Fix list (same claim, patch round to the original dev)

1. **(HIGH: R6)** Keep the field gate asking about `title` when the object declares it, alongside `documentTitleField(schema)`, for as long as the index may hold documents assembled under the old rule. A union in `servedFieldsOf` fails closed.
   - Replace the test `preservation: hiding a \`title\` field that is not the display field does not refuse the source` with a refusal pin. The adapter in that pin returns a stored hit carrying an old-rule `title`, and the test is red on the current head.
   - Write the retirement condition in the code comment and the PR body: the index is proven rebuilt under the new title rule (ADR-0161 K7 recipe hash, #37099).
   - Correct the report's `security_findings` line.
   - Another fail-closed design is acceptable if it comes with the same red-then-green pin.
2. **(Card #36993 point 2: R5)** Count survivors toward `topK` by distinct record in the refill decision (`knowledge-service.ts:566`). The key is `sourceId` plus `sourceRecordId` for object hits and `documentId` for file or http hits. The answer stays at most `topK` chunk-level hits.
   - Add the several-sources case from R5 as a test that is red without the change.
   - Rewrite the Acceptance note to match.
   - If the dev still holds the item should not be applied, the question goes to the card owner. It cannot close by `Fixes` on the current reasoning.
3. **Changeset:** say that a caller who may not query the object's display field does not have the source searched at all. With fix 1, also say that a declared `title` field still gates the source until the index is rebuilt.
4. **Docs and TSDoc wording** (R9):
   - Rewrite `knowledge.mdx:190` and the `SEARCH_REFILL_FACTOR` TSDoc as "a caller who may read fewer than `topK` of the rows within the cap gets fewer than `topK` hits".
   - In `knowledge-rag.mdx`, say the over-ask is for a caller other than the system identity.
   - In `knowledge-rag.mdx`, replace "the record's display name … (`nameField`)" with "the value of the object's display field (`nameField`, else the derived title field)".
5. **PR body:** correct the maintainer summary's 「权限只会更严」 to match what fix 1 makes true. Update the Acceptance notes for fixes 1 and 2. Re-run `scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` against #37287 before the push.

Seat-side item, not the dev's: revise the claim's file surface on #36993 to include `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx` and `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`.

### L2 verdict

Not owed. Governing text, `references/contract-review.md` 〈L2 归属与资格〉:

> L2 面 = 契约四面:`Clause-②: yes` 申报、收窄申报、已发布 schema(`packages/spec/src/**` 非测试)、governed 规则文本 … `.changeset`/CHANGELOG、`content/docs/**`、`apps/docs/**` 散文面 ⛔ 不在其列。

> 四面皆不碰 ⇒ CI 加席位自读 ⛔ 不起第二个 agent。

How each face reads:
- The PR body and the changeset both declare `Clause-②: no`, and that holds (R9 and the Changeset line).
- No `(narrowing)` arm.
- No file under `packages/spec/src/**`.
- No governed path. Checked against `.github/CODEOWNERS` Tier H, and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is `success`.

The fixes above do not add a face. Re-check the faces on the next head.

## 席位核对 (round 2)

Verdict: ACCEPT
Head-sha: `46217388a8d037b1dd6c6a51d4a067b6c3236030`

L1 reviewer of record. This round reads the delta from `2b95b310` to `46217388` (2 commits, fast-forward, 7 files, +81/−26) against the five round-1 fix items. The reading comes from the fetched PR tree and GitHub, not from re-report 7165845829.

Setup: `git fetch origin pull/37301/head` gives `46217388a8d0…`, and the PR API `head.sha` matches. In a fresh worktree at that head I installed the package's dependency closure (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter "@objectstack/service-knowledge..."`) and built it (`OS_SKIP_DTS=1 pnpm --filter "@objectstack/service-knowledge^..." build`). `npx vitest run` in `packages/services/service-knowledge` then gave **8 files / 219 tests passed**, which matches the re-report.

### Fix items

1. **Field gate keeps asking about a declared `title` field: done.**
   - `knowledge-source-admission.ts` `servedFieldsOf` adds `documentTitleField(schema)` and still adds `title` whenever the object declares it or its fields cannot be enumerated. That is main's line unchanged, so the served set at this head contains main's served set.
   - The retirement condition (ADR-0161 K7 recipe hash, #37099) is in the code comment, the module TSDoc and the PR body's Acceptance notes.
   - The pin `refusal: a declared \`title\` the caller may not query still refuses the source — a stored hit may carry its value` has the adapter return a stored hit with an earlier-rule title, and asserts `[]` and that the source is not searched.
   - Ablation: deleting the arm turns that pin red (1 failed / 150 passed across the two suites), and restoring it gives a clean `git diff HEAD`.
   - The round-1 probe re-run at this head answers `[]`, the same as main.
2. **Refill decision counts records: done.**
   - `knowledge-service.ts` `search` now refills when `distinctRecords(kept) < topK`. `distinctRecords` keys an object hit by `sourceId#sourceRecordId` and any other hit by its `documentId`.
   - The answer is still `kept.slice(0, topK)` chunk-level hits, so the `topK` contract ("Max number of hits to return") holds.
   - New pin: topK 3 over sources s1 and s2 answers `['s1-c0','s1-c15','s2-a']`, with calls `[['s1',15],['s2',15],['s1',60]]`.
   - Ablation: going back to `kept.length` turns that pin red (1 failed / 150 passed). Disabling the refill turns 7 red, the 6 from round 1 plus the new pin.
   - The round-1 several-sources probe at this head answers `["s1:rec_0@1","s1:rec_15@0.985","s2:r@0.5"]`.
   - The Acceptance note now says the count changes the answer when there are several sources, and that the cut stays at chunk level.
   - Card #36993 point 2 is delivered, so `Fixes #36993` is now correct.
3. **Changeset: done.** I checked each changed sentence against the code:
   - Bullet 1 now says "name fewer than `topK` records (several passages of one record count once)", which matches `distinctRecords`.
   - Bullet 2 now says a source whose display field the caller may not query "is not searched for that caller at all", and that a declared `title` still gates the source until a complete reindex. Both match `servedFieldsOf`.
   - `'@objectstack/service-knowledge': patch`, `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are unchanged and still hold.
4. **Docs and TSDoc wording: done.** I read each changed sentence against the diff:
   - `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx` §3.2: the refill now counts records, and the garbled cap sentence now reads "a caller who may read fewer than `topK` of the rows within the cap gets fewer than `topK` hits".
   - `knowledge.mdx`, the new title paragraph sentence and the field-level rules bullet (now "and a declared `title` field"): both match `servedFieldsOf`.
   - `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx`: "for a caller other than the system identity" and "when too few records survive" are added, and "the value of the object's display field (`nameField`, else the derived title field)" replaces "the record's display name".
   - The `SEARCH_REFILL_FACTOR` TSDoc carries the same corrected sentence.
5. **PR body: done.**
   - The maintainer summary now says permission checks only increase, which is true at this head (gate served set contains main's).
   - The Acceptance notes now cover the record-counting decision and the temporary declared-`title` arm. The Tests and Ablations sections list both new pins.
   - Closing keywords are `Fixes #36993` and `Fixes #36994` only, both folded cards and both delivered. No other open card number sits next to a closing keyword.

### Other readings

- **Overlap:** `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=refs/l1/37301-r2 --pr=37287` merges cleanly against origin/main `9e6533bd48` and #37287 (`VERDICT clean exit 0`). The same run with `--pr=37265` also merges cleanly against origin/main and #37265 (`VERDICT clean exit 0`).
- **Re-report 7165845829:** its test count and the two new ablations match my runs. It still says `security_findings: none`. I accept that, because the round-1 finding was in this PR's own earlier head, never reached `main`, and is closed at this head.
- **Out-of-scope destination:** retiring the declared-`title` arm goes to #37099. The re-report says "noted not filed", so the seat records the retirement condition on #37099 at landing.
- **Seat-side (round-1 item):** the claim file surface on #36993 still needs `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx` and `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` added.

### Gate check-runs at 46217388 (CI had just started)

- Complete and passing: TypeScript Type Check, Check Changeset, all four `Type Check ·` jobs, plus 31 success and 17 expected skipped in total.
- **Lint & Repo Gates:** no check-run yet, so NOT MEASURED.
- **In progress, NOT MEASURED:** Build Docs, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus`, Test Core 1/10 to 5/10.
- No failures so far.

### L2 verdict

Not owed. Governing text, `references/contract-review.md` 〈L2 归属与资格〉:

> L2 面 = 契约四面:`Clause-②: yes` 申报、收窄申报、已发布 schema(`packages/spec/src/**` 非测试)、governed 规则文本 … `.changeset`/CHANGELOG、`content/docs/**`、`apps/docs/**` 散文面 ⛔ 不在其列。

> 四面皆不碰 ⇒ CI 加席位自读 ⛔ 不起第二个 agent。

The delta adds no face:
- The declaration is still `Clause-②: no`. `distinctRecords` is module-private, and `src/index.ts` is unchanged.
- No `(narrowing)` arm.
- No `packages/spec/src/**` file.
- No governed path.

### Landing notes
